expected_behavior: Runs calendar selection first if it hasn't happened yet this run, and asks the user to pick a writable calendar
Runs `bin/plan_day --calendar-id <picked> --timezone America/Los_Angeles` with no date argument for today
Does not hardcode a UTC offset or otherwise bypass plan_day's zoneinfo-based day-window math
Presents each event as Title / Date / Time / Location / URL, with a blank line between events
Handles a day with zero events by saying so, without inventing placeholder events
